premises.failed_step: The text path truncates each description to 30 characters, but `statement_csv` writes `statement_rows` output with the full description. A CSV export therefore prints description text the base `statement` command never printed. The rest of the premise holds: the base CLI never called `can_view`, and the CSV path adds no authorization decision. The extra exposure is low impact because the caller already supplies and can read the ledger FILE, and no authorization boundary exists to bypass.
